# Rebuilt wheels

## imgui-2.0.0-cp314-cp314-win_amd64.whl

sha256 `cfc2c70ee628327330d4e3bfe6c313f5d2470ebbc19147aa0bec1043584bd07e`

aitviewer needs `imgui` 2.0.0 (pyimgui). PyPI gives only an sdist, built in 2023. Its C++ was generated by
Cython 0.29, which calls CPython functions that Python 3.13/3.14 changed (`_PyLong_AsByteArray`,
`_PyGen_SetStopIterationValue`). So the sdist does not compile on 3.14. On 3.12, uv still builds the
unchanged sdist from PyPI. pyproject.toml uses this wheel only when `python_version >= '3.14'`.

Recipe (2026-11-18, Python 3.14.10, MSVC 14.44 from Visual Studio 2022):

1. Download `imgui-2.0.0.tar.gz` from PyPI. Its sha256 is
   `2fbdb8eed3b8dbd7ea98af9e4c1c6582b0bc4da942a258de16333d8c653d67e1`.
2. In the unpacked folder, with Cython 3.3.1, regenerate the C++:
   `cythonize(['imgui/core.pyx','imgui/internal.pyx'], include_path=['imgui','.'],
   compiler_directives={'language_level': 2, 'legacy_implicit_noexcept': True}, force=True)`
   `language_level=2` keeps the integer `/` of the original code (Cython 0.29 semantics).
   `legacy_implicit_noexcept` keeps the old exception behaviour of the C callbacks.
3. Uninstall Cython, so that `setup.py` compiles the new `.cpp` files and does not cythonize again, then
   run `python setup.py bdist_wheel`.

Check: create a context, run one frame with a slider and a button, render, destroy (imgui_smoke test).
